answer_1.quote: This paper explores Open-LTG with NAR models based on pre-trained MLMs.

answer_2.quote: We utilize BLEU (B-n), ROUGE (R-n), Lexical Repetition (LR-n, 4-gram repetition for n-times), Semantic Repetition (SR-n, average top-n semantic similarity between any two sentences), average semantic overlap (S-m, average semantic similarity of all the sentences), Distinct (D-n) and BERTScore for the storytelling task.

answer_4.quote: We hire three annotators to give their preferences (win, loss and tie) for three evaluation criteria: fluency, coherence, and relevance, which reflect the intra-sentence linguistic quality, inter-sentence relatedness & causal dependency and consistency of the generation results, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: annotators are asked to select the better text in each comparison in terms of fluency, coherence, and relevance
